notes.title: First!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We're alive![/b][/h1]

[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We know it's been pretty quiet on this page over the past few months — thanks so much for your patience! Since launching the game's Steam page, we've been hard at work getting [b]Leaforia[/b] to a place we're truly proud of.

[b]We’ve got an important announcement coming in the next few days, so stay tuned.[/b]

We're also planning to start sharing more updates about the game's development here soon!
